narrative:
The FY2027 BU plan carries GBP 3.80B of revenue, up 6.3% on the FY2026 Q3 forecast of GBP 3.58B and GBP 50M short of the GBP 3.85B ambition.

UK Insurance is the engine at GBP 2.01B (53% of the plan): Corporate PMI renewals are priced ahead of claims inflation with retention holding, and Individual PMI grows through direct digital sales. Dental Care (GBP 540M) grows on private plans and insured patients treated in Bupa practices, while NHS dental contract income stays flat. Clinics & Hospitals is the fastest-growing unit (+13% to GBP 350M) as King Edward VII and New Victoria hospitals ramp up. Care Services (GBP 420M) holds occupancy and phases fee increases from April; Bupa Global (GBP 480M) grows on international PMI renewals.

Key risk: two large corporate schemes moved renewal dates, so London & South East revenue is running behind the monthly profile — the BU Revenue Forecaster has GBP 82M of proposals on the table to close the gap to ambition.

signals.title: Bupa Global, India & UK revenue +11%, underlying profit +23%
signals.excerpt: Market unit revenue rose 11% to £3.1bn on customer growth and average premiums; underlying profit rose 23% to £154m.

signals.title: Bupa Dental Care margins improve
signals.excerpt: Revenue and underlying profit increased as clinics treated higher volumes of Bupa dental insurance customers, alongside strong Bupa Smile Plan performance.

signals.title: King Edward VII and New Victoria hospitals join UK Health Services
signals.excerpt: UK Health Services revenue grew on higher volumes and the two acquisitions; underlying profit reduced as Bupa invests for growth.
